kangaroo-at-2018-felix-01.title: Draw in order
kangaroo-at-2018-felix-01.body:
Count the points: the left beetle has 1, the right one 2, the top one 3, the bottom left one 4 and the bottom right one 5.

- 1 → 2: a line straight across the middle.
- 2 → 3: a slanted line up to the top.
- 3 → 4: a long slanted line down to the bottom left, crossing the first line.
- 4 → 5: a line straight across the bottom.

This is figure D.

**Answer: (D)**

kangaroo-at-2018-felix-02.title: Count and share
kangaroo-at-2018-felix-02.body:
The left park has 16 kangaroos and the right park has 6. Together there are 22, so each park should have $22 \div 2 = 11$. Move $16 - 11 = 5$ kangaroos.

Check: $16 - 5 = 11$ and $6 + 5 = 11$. ✓

**Answer: (B) 5**

kangaroo-at-2018-felix-02.title: Half the difference
kangaroo-at-2018-felix-02.body:
The left park has $16 - 6 = 10$ more. Each kangaroo moved makes the left park one smaller and the right park one bigger, so moving half of 10, which is 5, makes them equal.

**Answer: (B) 5**

kangaroo-at-2018-felix-03.title: Take away the extra
kangaroo-at-2018-felix-03.body:
The beetles have 5, 7, 5, 6 and 4 dots. Altogether $5 + 7 + 5 + 6 + 4 = 27$ dots. That is $27 - 20 = 7$ too many, so the beetle with 7 points must fly away.

**Answer: (B)**

kangaroo-at-2018-felix-04.title: Continue the pattern
kangaroo-at-2018-felix-04.body:
The pattern is 9 squares wide: up 3, right 3, down 3, right 1, up 2, right 2, down 2, right 1, up 1, right 1, down 1, right 1. The second copy starts where the first one ends.

The third copy starts at the end of the second copy, on the bottom line. Its first part is the tall box (3 squares high, 3 wide), then right 1, then a box 2 squares high and 2 squares wide. The top right corner of this second box is exactly at point D. The points A, B, C and E are not on any of the lines.

**Answer: (D) D**

kangaroo-at-2018-felix-05.title: Wider than everything above
kangaroo-at-2018-felix-05.body:
From above you see a disc only if it sticks out beyond all the discs on top of it. Go from the top down: the top disc is seen. A disc lower down is seen only if it is wider than every disc above it.

In the tower, this happens for 3 discs (the top one and two wider ones further down). The other discs are hidden under wider discs above them.

**Answer: (C) 3**

kangaroo-at-2018-felix-06.title: Find both sheets
kangaroo-at-2018-felix-06.body:
Each answer must contain the lines of the first sheet (an L with a slanted line) and the lines of the second sheet (a dot with two short lines), possibly turned or flipped, and nothing else.

In D, the first sheet appears as the long vertical line, the top line and the slanted line, and the second sheet's dot with its two short lines fits exactly at the middle dot. Every other picture has a line too many or a line missing.

**Answer: (D)**

kangaroo-at-2018-felix-07.title: Walk each path
kangaroo-at-2018-felix-07.body:
Imagine walking along each path from the dog to the bone and say "left" or "right" at every corner. Remember that left and right depend on the direction you are walking.

Only path E has 3 right turns and 2 left turns.

**Answer: (E)**

kangaroo-at-2018-felix-08.title: Try the pieces
kangaroo-at-2018-felix-08.body:
The hole is 3 pieces in a row. Along the frame it has round bulges, so every side of a piece that touches the frame must have a bump. Where two pieces meet, one needs a bump and the other a dent.

Turn the pieces and try them: B, C and D fill the hole exactly, with their dents taking the bumps of their neighbours. So piece A, which has a bump on every side, is left over.

**Answer: (A) A**

kangaroo-at-2018-felix-09.title: Knots make it shorter
kangaroo-at-2018-felix-09.body:
Every knot uses up some rope, so the more knots a piece has, the shorter it becomes. The piece with 1 knot must be the longest and the piece with 3 knots the shortest.

Only picture B shows this.

**Answer: (B)**

kangaroo-at-2018-felix-10.title: Hold up your hand
kangaroo-at-2018-felix-10.body:
For each picture, use your own hands: hold your right hand in the same position. Look at where the thumb is compared with the palm or the back of the hand. If you can copy the picture with your right hand, it is a right hand.

Going through all 10 hands, 5 of them are right hands.

**Answer: (C) 5**

kangaroo-at-2018-felix-11.title: Count the spots
kangaroo-at-2018-felix-11.body:
The visible sides have 4, 3, 5 and 3 spots: $4 + 3 + 5 + 3 = 15$. The other sides have the same, so there are $15 + 15 = 30$ spots. So 30 dwarfs fit, and $36 - 30 = 6$ get wet.

**Answer: (E) 6**

kangaroo-at-2018-felix-12.title: List them
kangaroo-at-2018-felix-12.body:
The first digit must be 1 or 2 (numbers from 11 to 24).

- Starting with 1: 10 is not bigger than 10, 11 has two equal digits, so 12 and 18.
- Starting with 2: 20 and 21 (22 has equal digits, 28 is too big).

That is 12, 18, 20, 21: 4 numbers.

**Answer: (A) 4**

kangaroo-at-2018-felix-13.title: Step by step
kangaroo-at-2018-felix-13.body:
First cut (white and grey pieces): 3 white become 6 white, 2 grey become 4 grey, and the 2 black stay. Now: 6 white, 2 black, 4 grey.

Second cut (black and grey pieces): 2 black become 4, 4 grey become 8. The 6 white stay.

Total: $6 + 4 + 8 = 18$.

**Answer: (D) 18**

kangaroo-at-2018-felix-14.title: Follow the lying sticks
kangaroo-at-2018-felix-14.body:
Go along the pattern from left to right on the lying sticks. From the left end to the right end there are 5 lying sticks one after the other: a pair on the left, a top stick of the first square, the middle pair, the top stick of the second square and the pair on the right.

Each one overlaps the next by 1 cm, the width of a standing stick. So the length is $5 \times 5 - 4 \times 1 = 21$ cm.

**Answer: (B) 21 cm**

kangaroo-at-2018-felix-15.title: Split at the crossing
kangaroo-at-2018-felix-15.body:
Anna to Mary (16 km) goes via the crossing, and the crossing to Mary is 9 km, so Anna to the crossing is $16 - 9 = 7$ km.

Mary to John (20 km) also goes via the crossing, so the crossing to John is $20 - 9 = 11$ km.

Anna to John: $7 + 11 = 18$ km.

**Answer: (E) 18 km**

kangaroo-at-2018-felix-15.title: Add and remove
kangaroo-at-2018-felix-15.body:
Anna to Mary plus Mary to John is $16 + 20 = 36$ km. This uses the piece from the crossing to Mary twice (there and back): $36 - 2 \times 9 = 18$ km.

**Answer: (E) 18 km**
